title: Definitely NOT for side sleepers !!!!
text: Definitely NOT for side sleepers !!!!. Slept on these for two nights and had neck strain both mornings after!  Definitely not designed for a side sleeper.  The pillows fluff up way too much.  Yes, they are soft and squishy, but not food for me.  Passed them on to my grandson and went with my old standby, new feather pillows.  Now THOSE work for side sleepers.

product_metadata.title: lunaoo Bed Pillows for Sleeping 2 Pack with Soft and Breathable Cover Neck Pillows for Side, Back, Stomach Sleepers, Pillows Queen Size Set of 2
